experiment: Frozen task-SVD-directed releases in author-order eight-expert TA0.2; three datasets evaluated
table_note: Same frozen task-SVD-directed releases as the two-expert TA0.5 experiment; no reconstruction or selection from these scores. All three standalone gates already passed. Known-family global-coordinate recovery still applies. Historically exposed tests; no tuning. Eight experts participate but only MNIST,DTD,SVHN are evaluated; no eight-task average. No all-expert AGA run in this setting.
mechanism_question: At the public-base patch term, I+0.2(P-I) has eigenvalues1 and0.6 for paired involutions,whereas0.5 gives1 and0. This tests whether prior protection survives without that rank collapse in the fixed author eight-expert setting; it is not an isolated coefficient ablation or a classification guarantee.
fixed_after_results_policy: Retain every case. No order/rank/objective/coefficient/seed or release changes; no new candidate. Native and two-expert evidence remain unchanged. Failure is reported rather than repaired.
scope_limitations: Eight participating experts but only three full datasets evaluated; no eight-task average.
Protected-expert AGA follows original entry; eight-expert all-AGA not run.
Fixed native task checkpoints, not proven byte-identical to author paper files.
Current known-family recovery remains exact for the three releases; this experiment does not resolve it.

implementation_repair.change: Convert replay-context image count to a Python int before JSON serialization; no scientific changes.
